title: Refrain Love: Anata ni Aitai
native_title: リフレイン・ラブ ～あなたに逢いたい～
overview:
You are a university student in the college town of Sakurazaki. It is June 28th, and there are six months until Christmas Eve. Who will be at your side on December 24th?

Refrain Love is a romance simulation with a cast of seven men and women. Move around town on the map, attend your daytime classes, take a part-time job, spend time on a hobby, hang out with friends or ask a girl out on a date. Whether you put your friendships or your love life first is up to you.

- Saturn version adds many new event illustrations and an expanded bonus mode
- Two game discs, plus a music CD
